xml_snippets.Title: Classic (IdeoPresetCategoryDef)
xml_snippets.Label: classic
xml_snippets.Description Originale: Classic RimWorld without the ideoligion system. Good for your first few games, or when you're not trying to do something specific. All Ideology expansion content remains active.
xml_snippets.XML:
<IdeoPresetCategoryDef>

    <defName>Classic</defName>

    <label>classic</label>

    <description>Classic RimWorld without the ideoligion system. Good for your first few games, or when you're not trying to do something specific. All Ideology expansion content remains active.</description>

    <groupLabel>Classic</groupLabel>

  </IdeoPresetCategoryDef>
